title: HubSpot Products & Services Catalog | Pricing Overview
text:
HubSpot Products & Services Catalog | Pricing Overview

# HubSpot Product & Services Catalog

Looking for more details about HubSpot’s products and services? Here, you’ll find an overview of our pricing, product descriptions, features associated with each subscription, and any limits that apply. 

If you have questions, reach out to your HubSpot rep or call our sales team at +1 888-482-7768.

## Pricing Overview

Pricing for HubSpot’s products varies by product and can be referenced within each individual product section in this catalog. In general, products are available through the purchase of HubSpot Seats, which grant individual users access to specific features. With HubSpot Credits, you can also purchase additional capacity for certain features.

In your account, you also have the flexibility of reallocating the value of any additional unassigned seats to your choice of HubSpot Credits or another seat type. Learn more about the different types of HubSpot Seats and HubSpot Credits below.

### HubSpot Seats

Connect your teams to HubSpot’s customer platform with HubSpot Seats. HubSpot Seats reflect the manner and level of access your users have to your subscription services.

If you have a mix of Starter, Professional, and/or Enterprise products, all your Core Seats will have the highest level of access to features across your purchased subscription services and will be priced based on the highest level of your subscription services. For example, if you’re subscribed to both Marketing Hub Professional and Sales Hub Enterprise, your highest-level subscription would be Enterprise.

| Feature | STARTER | PROFESSIONAL | ENTERPRISE |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Core Seat Grants core access to all purchased products, built-in AI with Breeze Assistant, enriched data, and Smart CRM. | Access the features available in Starter subscriptions $20/month per seat | Access the features available in Professional subscriptions* $50/month per seat | Access the features available in Enterprise subscriptions* $75/month per seat |
| Sales Seat Grants complete access to Sales Hub Professional or Enterprise, including advanced features built for sellers. Sales Seat functionality also includes Core Seat access. | Not available | Full Sales Hub Professional functionality $100/month per seat | Full Sales Hub Enterprise functionality $150/month per seat |
| Service Seat Grants complete access to Service Hub Professional or Enterprise, including advanced features built for service teams. Service Seat functionality also includes Core Seat access. | Not available | Full Service Hub Professional functionality $100/month per seat | Full Service Hub Enterprise functionality $150/month per seat |
| Revenue Seat Grants complete access to Revenue Hub Professional or Enterprise, including advanced CPQ tools. Revenue Seat functionality also includes Core Seat access. | Not available | Full Revenue Hub Professional functionality $95/month per seat | Full Revenue Hub Enterprise functionality $140/month per seat |
| View-Only Seat Allows a user to view the subscription services without making any changes to their account. | Available at no additional cost | Available at no additional cost | Available at no additional cost |
| Partner Seats Allows a user to view the subscription services without making any changes to their account. You agree to grant or confirm a Partner Seat exclusively for HubSpot Solutions Partners you’re actively working with and who need this access to perform services in your subscription services; HubSpot will confirm, deny, or remove Partner Seats in our sole, reasonable discretion. | Available at no additional cost | Available at no additional cost | Available at no additional cost |

*Full Sales Hub Professional or Enterprise, Service Hub Professional or Enterprise, and Revenue Hub Professional or Enterprise functionality requires a Sales Seat, Service Seat, or Revenue Seat, respectively. 

Customers on HubSpot’s flexible seats-and-credits pricing do not have access to Core, Sales, Service, or Revenue Seats. For more information on seat types available on flexible seats-and-credits pricing, visit the Flexible Seats-and-Credits Product & Services Supplement. 

### HubSpot Credits

HubSpot Credits are a simple, flexible way to power AI agents and automation that get work done for you across HubSpot’s customer platform. Your HubSpot Credits reset monthly during your subscription term. Unused credits do not roll over into the following month.

Some HubSpot products include HubSpot Credits at no additional cost. Included credits are not additive across products. If you’re a customer with multiple products, you’ll receive the highest available credit allotment based on the highest level of your subscription services. For example, if you’re subscribed to both Marketing Hub Professional and Sales Hub Enterprise, your highest-level subscription would be Enterprise.

Learn more in the “ Manage HubSpot Credits” knowledge base article, which covers setting credit limits for specific features, monitoring usage, and more.

#### Included Credits

| INCLUDED CREDITS | STARTER | PROFESSIONAL | ENTERPRISE |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Amount of credits granted with your purchase of Smart CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, or Revenue Hub | 500 credits | 3,000 credits | 5,000 credits |
| Amount of credits granted with your purchase of Data Hub or Customer Platform* | 500 credits | 5,000 credits | 10,000 credits |

*Customer Platform includes the Starter, Professional, or Enterprise edition of HubSpot’s products, bundled together.

...

#### Additional Credits

If you purchase additional credits, you can continue to use credits beyond your total monthly credits. You can choose when and how to add HubSpot Credits to your account at $0.010 per credit. Choose from Pay-as-You-Go for more flexibility, or capacity pack add-ons or upgrades for more credits through your term.

...

We aim to be transparent about our product packaging and the limits that apply, so we hope you find this catalog useful. Please note that the fees we provide here are subject to applicable taxes and that all purchases are subject to the HubSpot Customer Terms of Service. We periodically update this catalog by posting a revised copy at https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog, so please check back here for current information.

title: HubSpot's Starter Plan for Startups & Small Businesses
text:
HubSpot's Starter Plan for Startups & Small Businesses

# For Startups & Small Businesses

Built for those doing everything at once. Build demand, win more deals, and automate the grind.

...

## How does HubSpot’s Starter plan compare to Free?

Starter unlocks higher usage limits, additional features, the removal of HubSpot branding, and more. Take a look at a high-level comparison below, or see more details on the pricing page.

| | Free | Starter |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HubSpot branding | HubSpot branding included on emails, forms, live chat, meeting links, etc. | No HubSpot branding |
| Usage limits | Limited usage | Higher usage limits across features |
| Customer support | Community and knowledge base access | Email and live in-app chat support |
| Automation | 1 automated action per email 1 automated email per form | Additional automations from contact, company, and deal pages, plus form, email, ticket, project, and ad automation |
| CRM | Basic CRM 10 custom properties 1,000 total contacts | Full CRM with 1,000 custom properties, advanced organization, expanded reporting, and the ability to purchase more marketing contacts |
| Users | 2 users | Unlimited users with seats purchased per user Team permission controls |
| Agents (uses HubSpot Credits) | | |
| HubSpot payment processing | | |

...

## Buy Starter Today and Save up to 65%

For a limited time, we’re offering new customers up to 65% off HubSpot’s Starter plan. Save more with an upfront annual payment, or pay month-to-month for more flexibility.

### Pay Annually

Starts at

$7/month $20 month per seat*

 Billed annually 

### Pay Monthly

Starts at

$10/month $20/month per seat*

 Billed monthly

...

### What’s the difference between HubSpot’s free and Starter plans? 

HubSpot’s free plan gives you core tools to get started with no cost and no commitment.

Starter is made for when you're ready to grow. You can remove HubSpot branding, do more with higher usage limits, get access to email and chat support, plus additional functionality like automation, agents, payments, notetaker, meeting prep, digital signatures, multi-currency, conversation routing, email sync, robust reporting, dedicated phone number, and much more.

Free gets you in the door. Starter gets you moving. See the full breakdown on the pricing page.

...

### What can make my HubSpot Starter bill increase? 

Your HubSpot Starter bill can change if you upgrade, add seats, purchase an add-on or capacity pack, or exceed an included limit such as your marketing contact tier.

Marketing email doesn’t have a separate send fee. Instead, your email send limit is based on the number of marketing contacts you purchase. Payment processing and some other usage-based services may have separate fees.

Some AI features and agents use HubSpot Credits, which are separate from your subscription limits. Starter includes 500 credits per month, and if you need more, you may purchase additional credit capacity or incur overage charges if you choose to enable overages in your account. For the most current details on pricing, features, limits, credits, and applicable fees, see the Product and Services Catalog.

### How many users can I have with HubSpot’s Starter plan, and how much do additional users cost? 

Starter is normally priced at $20/month per seat, but for a limited time, we’re offering new customers up to 65% off. Pay $7/mo per seat, with upfront payment and annual commitment. Or pay month-to-month at $10/month per seat, with no annual commitment.

Customers with a Starter subscription may purchase additional core Starter seats at any time to add new users to their account. For more details, visit our pricing page.
